newsFeed.headline: Red Sea shipping disruptions push insurers and carriers to reroute capacity again
newsFeed.summary: Fresh security incidents drove more carriers away from the Suez route, raising transit times and freight uncertainty.
newsFeed.whyItMatters: Any hardware, electronics, or imported goods exposure faces renewed delivery risk and possible cost creep.

newsFeed.headline: China signals targeted stimulus for property and local-government stress
newsFeed.summary: Beijing outlined selective support rather than broad rescue measures as growth and debt pressures persist.
newsFeed.whyItMatters: Supports a slower-growth global backdrop rather than a clean rebound; useful context for demand and market risk.

newsFeed.headline: Europe moves toward tighter export controls on dual-use chips and tooling
newsFeed.summary: Officials are discussing narrower but firmer controls tied to semiconductor and advanced-manufacturing equipment.
newsFeed.whyItMatters: Another incremental constraint on tech supply chains and pricing; relevant for compute and vendor exposure.

newsFeed.headline: Oil holds higher after OPEC+ supply discipline and new regional risk premium
newsFeed.summary: Crude stayed elevated as supply restraint met renewed geopolitical tension.
newsFeed.whyItMatters: Sustained energy strength can leak into transport, hosting, and broad operating costs.

newsFeed.headline: Japan wage data keeps Bank of Japan normalization path alive
newsFeed.summary: Wage growth remained firm enough to preserve expectations for gradual policy normalization.
newsFeed.whyItMatters: Another reminder that global rates may stay less forgiving than markets hope.

newsFeed.headline: Brazil and Argentina reopen talks on regional trade settlement mechanisms
newsFeed.summary: The discussion centers on easing cross-border settlement friction rather than launching a near-term shared currency.
newsFeed.whyItMatters: Background signal on regional trade plumbing; low immediate impact but worth watching for payments exposure.

topStories.headline: Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 with extended thinking and tool use improvements
topStories.summary: Major model upgrade with significant gains in reasoning, code generation, and agentic workflows. Pricing unchanged for existing tiers.
topStories.whyItMatters: Direct impact on current tooling stack. Evaluate upgrade path and test against existing prompts.

topStories.headline: OpenAI announces GPT-5 Turbo with native multimodal output
topStories.summary: GPT-5 Turbo supports text, image, and audio output in a single call. Enterprise pricing starts at $30/M tokens.
topStories.whyItMatters: Competitive pressure on model selection. Compare pricing and capability against current stack.

topStories.headline: EU AI Act enforcement timeline moved up to Q3 2026
topStories.summary: Compliance deadlines accelerated for high-risk AI systems. Penalties up to 7% of global revenue.
topStories.whyItMatters: Review any EU-facing deployments. May need compliance audit earlier than planned.

topStories.headline: Google DeepMind open-sources Gemma 3 model family
topStories.summary: Gemma 3 models (2B, 9B, 27B) released under permissive license. Strong benchmarks on code and reasoning.
topStories.whyItMatters: Potential cost savings for lightweight tasks. Evaluate for on-device or self-hosted use cases.

topStories.headline: Meta launches open-source AI agent framework
topStories.summary: New framework for building multi-step AI agents. Integrates with LLaMA models.
topStories.whyItMatters: Monitor for ecosystem shifts. No immediate action needed.

whyItMatters.recommendedAction: Benchmark current usage against new pricing tiers before next billing cycle

whyItMatters.recommendedAction: Audit current AI usage for EU exposure; flag any high-risk categorizations
